boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten free, daylight-friendly outdoor meet-ups in St. Olaf’s Natural Lands.

cards.title: Walk Big Pond Loop
cards.subtitle: St. Olaf Natural Lands trail
cards.notes: Meet at the Big Pond trailhead, take the loop at an easy pace, and pause to notice the prairie and wetland views together.
cards.short_summary: A short named loop for a no-cost outdoor catch-up.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Olaf’s Natural Lands map identifies Big Pond Loop, and the City of Northfield states that the public has free access to trails in the natural areas around St. Olaf.
cards.access_notes: The Natural Lands are open to the public from 5 a.m. to 10 p.m.; remain on marked trails and follow posted notices.

cards.title: Take the Baseball Pond Loop
cards.subtitle: St. Olaf Natural Lands trail
cards.notes: Use this named loop for a walking conversation, then head back before dark; bring water and leave plants and wildlife undisturbed.
cards.short_summary: A free trail loop beside a named Natural Lands pond.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Olaf’s Natural Lands map identifies Baseball Pond Loop, and the City of Northfield states that the public has free access to trails in the natural areas around St. Olaf.
cards.access_notes: The Natural Lands are open to the public from 5 a.m. to 10 p.m.; stay on designated routes and observe trail conditions.

cards.title: Climb Norway Valley Trail
cards.subtitle: St. Olaf Natural Lands trail
cards.notes: Choose this wooded trail for a brief daylight reset with friends; its narrow, uneven route calls for sturdy shoes and a slower pace.
cards.short_summary: A free wooded walk through a named Natural Lands area.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Olaf’s Natural Lands map identifies Norway Valley Trail, and the City of Northfield states that the public has free access to trails in the natural areas around St. Olaf.
cards.access_notes: The Natural Lands are open to the public from 5 a.m. to 10 p.m.; the college describes Norway Valley as narrow and steep in places.

cards.title: Walk Heath Creek Trail
cards.subtitle: St. Olaf Natural Lands trail
cards.notes: Plan a daylight walk with a friend along this named trail, keeping to the route and giving yourself extra time after rain or snow.
cards.short_summary: A free trail hang in the Heath Creek section of the Natural Lands.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Olaf’s Natural Lands map identifies Heath Creek Trail, and the City of Northfield states that the public has free access to trails in the natural areas around St. Olaf.
cards.access_notes: The Natural Lands are open to the public from 5 a.m. to 10 p.m.; use marked trails and comply with any seasonal restrictions.

cards.title: Head Out on Windmill Trail
cards.subtitle: St. Olaf Natural Lands trail
cards.notes: Use the trail for a quick shared walk and a view of the wind turbine; stay together, follow the marked route, and pack out trash.
cards.short_summary: A free named trail with a campus wind-turbine landmark nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Olaf’s Natural Lands map identifies Windmill Trail, and the City of Northfield states that the public has free access to trails in the natural areas around St. Olaf.
cards.access_notes: The Natural Lands are open to the public from 5 a.m. to 10 p.m.; use designated paths and follow posted safety guidance.

cards.subtitle: St. Olaf Natural Lands trail

cards.short_summary: A free woodland walk for a quiet two-person or small-group hang.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Olaf’s Natural Lands map identifies Ellingson Woods Trail, and the City of Northfield states that the public has free access to trails in the natural areas around St. Olaf.

cards.title: Circle the Prairie Loop
cards.subtitle: St. Olaf Natural Lands trail

cards.short_summary: A free named prairie route for an easy outdoor reset.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Olaf’s Natural Lands map identifies Prairie Loop, and the City of Northfield states that the public has free access to trails in the natural areas around St. Olaf.
